notes.title: Run x Gun Steam Demo Launch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44738891/162ccb07f929355082c94f8bbc8c88f079ab41ff.png[/img]

Hello everyone, Today I have finally released the demo for Run x Gun on Steam. If you are interested please try it out and any feed back is welcome. Also I recently updated the itch.io version to 0.7.5

Here is the change log for it:

Release Notes

Added: Shield Powerup
Changed: Adjusted Health Powerup spawn rate
Changed: Adjusted Weapon Spread Powerup spawn rate
Changed: Adjusted Weapon Burst Powerup spawn rate
